title: A click on the timeline does its job again: the Blade cuts, a cut opens its picker, a bar gets picked
goal: Since the evening of 2026-09-25, clicking things on the video timeline does nothing: a click on the join between two clips no longer opens the transition picker, a click with the Blade leaves the clip whole, and a click on a caption's bar picks nothing. Right-clicks still open their menus. Find the one change that stopped the clicks and put them back, so a transition, a cut and a pick can be made by clicking, as in Premiere.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-26 on main at 9968c2d1 with no local changes (stashed): Scripts/probe-app.sh; Scripts/playtest-all.sh --no-build transition-picker-at-a-cut-walk -> FAILED step 18 (expect): no control called "Cross dissolve" is in the panel (panel lists 'Edit point Tutorial Sample to b-roll' but no picker). a-video-edit-saves-as-a-project-walk -> FAILED step 34 (press): no control called "Cross dissolve" in "At this cut"; its 4-picker-sc.png shows the click landed on the join between the two Sample Talk pieces on V1 and no picker opened. Both passed in the 2026-09-25T23:33Z sweep (617/623), so the break is in a commit after it: 34757c2e (timeline bar says labels), 3235cde1 (drawn things get their own row), 3ac98a03 (captions one layer), bb6c6370, b237059c, bb17ceed, 688177b1, 9968c2d1 (clip shows its sound). Found by the runner of command-s-on-a-video-edit-does-what-the-user-pic. | RESOLVED 2026-09-26: no commit. A 'Photonz (Probe) quit unexpectedly' dialog (UserNotificationCenter, from the EXC_GUARD crash at 2026-09-25 23:22:53) held the front, so NSApp.isActive and window.isKeyWindow stayed false (logged at the press: key=false active=false) and a non-key window drops synthesized clicks on SwiftUI tap/drag gestures; Buttons fire. Bisect: 34757c2e^ and bb6c6370 both failed today, so the window was environment. Every /tmp/photonz-playtest log.json since 09-26 00:00 has appActive false (~640 runs). After killall UserNotificationCenter the probe is key+active and all six walks pass on unchanged HEAD. Guard: probe-app.sh Grants line '· a system alert is in front', and PlaytestHarness appends systemAlertInFront to a failed walk's error.
acceptance: At Next defaults, with two clips on V1, a click on the join between them opens the transition picker at that cut
With the Blade armed (tool bar, the timeline's bar or B), one click in the middle of a clip leaves it in two pieces and puts the playhead at the click; the same on its linked sound
A click on a caption's bar picks that one caption, and Shift-click on a second clip adds it to the pick
